content_metadata.description: An educational video explaining the nomenclature of ionic compounds, covering topics such as simple ions, transition metals, and polyatomic ions.

qAndA.question: What color is used to represent the cation in the ionic compound overview?
What suffix is typically used for the anion in a simple ionic compound?
What type of numeral is used to specify the charge of a transition metal cation?

qAndA.answer: To differentiate between cations of the same transition metal element that have different charges.
